text:
Easiest way to satisfy your pizza craving… plus it’s high fiber + protein 🍕🫘 healthy pizza beans recipe!

Ingredients:
- white kidney beans (2 cans - using @edenfoods)
- tomato sauce (1.5 cups - using @smashkitchen)
- olive oil (1 tbsp - using @getgraza)
- onion (1)
- kale (1 cup or as desired)
- garlic (4 cloves - using @dorotgardens)
- Italian seasoning (1 tsp - using @thespicehouse)
- mozzarella cheese (1/4 cup - using @organicvalley)
- Parmesan cheese (2 tbsp)
- salt (to taste)
* using @hexclad kitchenware
